items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I happened to be appearing at the Triangle nightclub there, which at that time was one of the popular nightclubs. And the very well-known gentleman owned the place was Al Capone. And I was working for him

ctx.x: Lee, how about Prohibition in Chicago? Oh, yes.

During my time of show business and back in the Prohibition days, I appeared at the various nightclubs there. And I happened to be appearing at the Triangle nightclub there, which at that time was one of the popular nightclubs. And the very well-known gentleman owned the place was Al Capone. And I was working for him, and there was a very successful engagement. And he had a lot of nice people working for him there, but he had some people working for him. It kind of took a liking to me, but I was a little bit…
Would you like to tell a little bit more about Henderson? Can you tell us about some of the, when you were back there a few years ago when they made it Leapage Day? Yes.
